summary: Registered adult nurse with three years' experience on a busy acute medical unit and a respiratory ward. Confident with IV therapy and caring for acutely unwell patients. Looking for a Band 6 role in acute medicine.

experience.title: Staff Nurse (Band 5), Acute Medical Unit
duties: Care for up to eight acutely unwell patients on a 32-bed acute medical unit
Give IV medicines and fluids and look after peripheral cannulas
Record observations and escalate patients with a rising NEWS2 score to the medical team
Admit patients from the emergency department and the GP assessment area
Support the nurse in charge with bed management on late shifts
achievements: Completed the trust's IV therapy and cannulation competencies in my first six months on the unit

experience.title: Staff Nurse (Band 5, preceptorship), Respiratory Ward
duties: Cared for patients with COPD, pneumonia and asthma on a 28-bed respiratory ward
Completed the trust's 12-month preceptorship programme for newly qualified nurses
